newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: French tourist drowns in central Australia.
newsitem.headline: French tourist drowns in central Australia.

text.p: A French tourist travelling in central Australia drowned while swimming with a friend in a water hole near Alice Springs, police said on Tuesday.
The man in his twenties, whose name was not released, got into difficulty at the Ellery Creek Big Hole, 88 km (55 miles) west of the town late on Monday, police said.
His body was recovered by police divers.
Water holes are scattered throughout the McDonnell mountain range, which stretches east and west of Alice Springs.
